dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare beneficiaries who rely on home urological and ostomy supplies, as well as suppliers and manufacturers.
dimensions.evidence: exclude urological and ostomy supplies from competitive acquisition programs under the Medicare program for 5 years

dimensions.assessment: Changes Medicare reimbursement rules, protects beneficiary access to preferred supplies, and creates new expert panels and surveys.
dimensions.evidence: the individual has the right to receive such urological and ostomy supplies from another supplier, or a non-contract supplier

dimensions.assessment: Modifies Medicare competitive bidding rules and requires the Secretary to conduct a technical expert panel, surveys, and a demonstration project.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall conduct a demonstration project to test the inclusion of urological and ostomy supplies

dimensions.assessment: Amends title XVIII of the Social Security Act by altering competitive acquisition rules, setting up panels, and establishing demonstration projects.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to exclude urological and ostomy supplies from competitive acquisition programs

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a 5-year exclusion period, a 1-year demonstration project, and ongoing technical panel reviews.
dimensions.evidence: exclude urological and ostomy supplies (as defined in section 1861(s)(8) furnished on or after January 1, 2028, and before January 1, 2033)

missing_information: Specific budgetary score or financial cost to the Medicare program resulting from the 5-year exclusion
importance_detail.rationale: Excludes urological and ostomy supplies from Medicare competitive acquisition programs for 5 years, establishes a technical expert panel, mandates a 3-State demonstration project, and prohibits suppliers from influencing brand switches.
